A1.justification: Both complete 20-page PDFs describe the same research, including Appendices A.1–A.7. Text and visual inspection support reliable comparison; pages 3–20 are identical in extracted text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v1 reports original provenance analyses in Section 3.3, training experiments and ablations in Section 4.2 and Tables 1–4, and further empirical analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original provenance analyses, training experiments, ablations, and appendix results reported in v1.

M1.justification: Sentence-level probability comparison, four-way provenance classification, teacher-guided data selection, and the threshold-search algorithm remain identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use AceReason-1.1-SFT, OpenThought3-1.2M, and OpenScienceReasoning 2 for training experiments and retain AIME24, AIME25, MATH500, OlympiadBench, and GPQA-D evaluation. No datasets, tasks, or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Vanilla/random selection and GRAPE remain the comparators in Tables 1 and 4. The selection-rule alternatives in Table 2 and comparisons in the appendices are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Sampling counts, evaluation metrics, training configurations, and procedures are unchanged. The abstract and introduction replace Qwen4-4B-Base with Qwen3-4B-Base, but Section 4.2 and Tables 1 and 5 already specified Qwen3-4B-Base in v1, establishing a naming correction rather than a changed experimental model.

E4.justification: Selection-metric ablations, threshold sensitivity, cross-domain experiments, behavioral analyses, distribution-alignment checks, and teacher-identification analyses are retained unchanged in Section 4.2.2 and Appendices A.2–A.4.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including point-estimate tables and qualifications about reliability at different action positions. No repeated-run or seed information, uncertainty intervals, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, plotted trends, and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains the proposed method's average accuracies of 58.7, 62.6, 57.7, and 76.4 under the same four settings; the remaining tables and appendix results also match.

T1.justification: The sentence-probability definition, probability differences, threshold-based classification conditions, and mathematical reasoning for threshold selection are unchanged. No assumptions, formal results, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: Both versions claim the same provenance-tracing framework, association between teacher-originated sentences and correctness, and benefits of teacher-guided selection. The model-name correction does not alter the supported experimental scope or conclusions.

C2.justification: Interpretations of teacher transfer, activated student patterns, and distribution alignment are unchanged. Qualifications concerning model scale, resource constraints, indirect distribution measurement, and multiple teachers are retained in Section 3.3 and the appendices.

D1.justification: Segmentation rules, threshold-selection details, training-data sampling instructions, and Table 5 hyperparameters are identical. No implementation details or code/data access information are added or revised.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix A.6, and the bibliography are unchanged. Positioning relative to GRAPE, knowledge distillation, and model auditing remains the same.

P1.justification: v2 corrects Qwen4-4B-Base to Qwen3-4B-Base in the abstract and introduction, updates affiliations, and identifies Chen Shen and Jieping Ye as corresponding authors. There is no broader prose rewrite or section reorganization.

P2.justification: An additional affiliation line and corresponding-author footnote reflow pages 1–2, pushing the end of the opening introduction paragraph onto page 2 and shifting Figure 1 downward. Figure content and captions are unchanged, as are all layouts from page 3 onward.

improvement.justification: v2 removes a model-name inconsistency in the abstract and introduction, bringing them into agreement with the Qwen3-4B-Base experiments already documented in v1, and clarifies author information. This provides a limited improvement in accuracy and clarity; the methods, empirical evidence, interpretations, and appendices are unchanged.
